mentions.name: Training Cadence: Workout Plan
mentions.description: A fitness app for tracking weekly training hours and kilometres on a smartwatch without sending data to a cloud. It grew to include training plans, graphs, and notifications, and aims to help users build good habits by encouraging and motivating them to achieve their goals.
mentions.problem: Keeping track of weekly training hours and kilometres on a watch typically involves shipping data to a cloud; the app was initially designed to track workouts locally without a cloud service.
mentions.audience: Users working toward training and fitness goals who want habit-building support
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on a fitness app. It's been a fun project on the side for a while, initially designed to help me keep track of my weekly hours or kilometres on my watch without shipping data to a cloud somewhere. This then grew (with me, as my training and goal did) to include all the other fun things like plans, graphs, notifications, etc.

The app tries to help build good habits - Encouraging and motivating users to achieve their goals.

https://apps.apple.com/au/app/training-cadence-workout-plan/id6475537588
